cwe_description: CWE-9901: Improper Ordering of Palette Hues — The product assigns colour values to interface elements, but it does not verify that adjacent hues follow the declared palette ordering.
CWE-9902: Reliance on Lunar Phase for Scheduling — The product schedules routine operations according to the phase of the moon without validating the almanac source.
CWE-9903: Excessive Politeness in Log Messages — The product writes log messages that contain more courteous phrases than the logging policy permits.
